plotSections.title: Raven Queen's Farewell to Sylan
bullets: The Raven Queen declines to grant Sylan anything further after he chooses not to ask for another boon, respecting his decision.
She urges Sylan to remember his past and future, value what he has, and not live in expectation of death because no one knows when their life will end.
The Raven Queen reminds Sylan that he has been given a weapon and identifies him as 'a talon of my order, not a butcher,' emphasizing precision and purpose over indiscriminate violence.
After delivering her final guidance, the Raven Queen transforms, unfurling large black wings and departing down the corridor, leaving the party with their allies.

plotSections.title: Testing the Portal
bullets: After the Raven Queen departs, the party experiments further with Gerk's portal-opening ability.
Each attempt produces a different destination, suggesting the portal's destination is not yet under Gerk's full control.
One portal opens onto a rainy mountain landscape, while another reveals a dark forest illuminated by glowing insects.
Dana recognizes the forest's flora as matching the forests surrounding Langdale, suggesting the portal may have connected somewhere near the party's homeland.
Walker recognizes a distinctive tree from his previous travels near Langdale, reinforcing that the portal likely connected close to home.
The party prevents anyone from immediately walking through the portal, deciding they should first discuss the major responsibility they have just received before leaving.

plotSections.title: Processing Their New Responsibility
bullets: Sylan encourages the group to pause and process the significance of the new responsibility they have been entrusted with before acting on their newfound travel capability.
Plymouth Gawater expresses interest in understanding Walker's claimed ability to travel between realms, though Walker jokes instead of explaining.

chronologicalEvents: The Raven Queen asks Sylan if he has any final request before she departs.
Sylan declines to ask for any additional favor.
The Raven Queen advises Sylan not to prepare for death, to value his life, and to act as a precise instrument of her order rather than a butcher.
The Raven Queen transforms into her winged form and flies away.
The remaining party members are left with Glimmen, Juten Prime, Elrus, Araden, Boris, Kit Anger, and Plymouth Gawater.
Gerk opens the portal several times, each attempt revealing a different destination.
The party observes a rainy mountainside through one portal.
A later portal reveals a dark forest.
Dana identifies the forest as resembling the forests around Langdale.
Walker recognizes a familiar tree from his previous travels near Langdale, supporting that the portal leads near home.
The party decides not to immediately enter the portal.
Sylan suggests everyone take time to process their new responsibility before leaving.
Plymouth questions Walker about his claimed ability to travel between realms, but Walker avoids answering seriously.
Dana asks Kit Anger for alcohol while anticipating further discussion with Plymouth.

Raven Queen.existing: God of the dead. Elder god.
notes: Gives Sylan final guidance focused on valuing life rather than expecting death.
Explicitly describes Sylan as 'a talon of my order, not a butcher,' defining how she expects him to use the power she granted him.
Departs by transforming into a winged, shadow-covered form and flying away.
personality: Respects Sylan's decision not to ask for another favor.
Encourages disciplined, purposeful action rather than needless killing.
